name: What is the difference between fire cleanup and smoke damage restoration?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between fire cleanup and smoke damage restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fire cleanup encompasses the overall process of restoring a property after a fire, which includes removing fire-damaged materials, debris, soot, and addressing structural issues. Smoke damage restoration is a specific component of fire cleanup that focuses on mitigating the effects of smoke, including removing smoke residue, neutralizing odors, and cleaning porous materials affected by smoke penetration. While fire cleanup is the broader term, smoke damage restoration is a critical and specialized part of the comprehensive recovery effort after a fire incident.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fire cleanup is the comprehensive restoration process after a fire, while smoke damage restoration specifically addresses removing smoke residue and odors from affected areas.
